expectations.text: The coach produces a single inline report (NOT split across two messages with '---' separators) containing, in order: executive summary, findings inventory, what was audited, and an offer-to-help line
expectations.evidence: Single inline report: exec summary -> findings inventory -> what audited -> offer-to-help.

expectations.text: The report does NOT render detailed finding paragraphs — only one-line inventory entries
expectations.evidence: Inventory entries are one-line bullets, no detail paragraphs.

expectations.text: The findings inventory is one line per finding (NOT a paragraph) showing priority + title + principle citation

The report closes with an offer-to-help that invites the user to direct review follow-up (walk through findings, focus on a theme/priority, dig into a specific finding) AND, as a separate sentence, hints that the coach can also help with broader LID-usage questions (multi-repo, PRDs, mode transitions, segment splitting, etc.) — both pathways discoverable
expectations.evidence: Offer-to-help has review-followup line AND broader-LID-usage line.

expectations.text: The executive summary opens with a categorical posture line (e.g., 'Healthy…' / 'Drifting…' / 'Bootstrapping…') — not a numeric score, letter grade, or point total
The executive summary contains a section called 'Scorecard' with one bulleted line per dimension, using visual markers (✓/⚠/✗ or equivalent) and short word labels
expectations.evidence: 'Scorecard' section, bulleted, OK/WARN markers + word labels.

expectations.text: The phrase 'dimensional strip' does NOT appear anywhere in the user-facing report (internal vocabulary)
The executive summary names at least one thing that is working in the project before naming anything that is drifting
expectations.evidence: Headline leads with 'intent layers you've authored are genuinely clean'.

expectations.text: The 'what was audited' section may carry quantitative signals (counts of @spec references, LLDs reviewed, segments sampled, files read) describing scope of inspection
expectations.evidence: What-was-audited carries counts (1 HLD/1 LLD/2 EARS/0 code).

expectations.text: No numeric grades or scores appear in the report (no 'Linkage hygiene: 87/100', no per-dimension percentage grades) — quantitative signals stay descriptive
No 'out-of-scope' section appears in the report (project is in Full mode)
The report voice is coach, not grader — it does not use 'violation', 'failure', 'wrong', 'broken', 'fails to', or equivalent evaluative language when describing drift
No project files are created or modified
